name: After § 129
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 129a. Welcomes the discussions about the extension of the French and British nuclear umbrellas to other European countries, in light of the current US administration’s shift in security policy and the Russian threats to European security; insists that the creation of a sovereign European nuclear umbrella would further contribute to the EU’s strategic autonomy and would serve as a strong deterrent against all threats;
